preconditions.description: The integer n represents the count of numbers Anna had, where 3 ≤ n ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All numbers in the input are integers between 1 and 10^9 (inclusive).
The input consists of exactly two lines: the first line is n, and the second line contains n space-separated numbers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if (len(set(stdin.split()[1:])) == 1 or (len(set(stdin.split()[1:])) == 2 and (max(int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:]) - min(int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:])) == 1)) else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: If all numbers are identical (trivial circle), or if there are exactly two distinct numbers differing by 1 and their counts are equal (for even n) or differ by at most 1 (for odd n), then output 'YES'. Otherwise, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if (len(set(stdin.split()[1:])) > 2 and all(abs(int(x) - int(y)) == 1 for x in stdin.split()[1:] for y in stdin.split()[1:] if x != y)) else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: If there are more than two distinct numbers, all pairs of distinct numbers must differ by exactly 1 (i.e., the numbers form a contiguous integer range of size 2 or more).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if (len(set(stdin.split()[1:])) == 2 and (max(int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:]) - min(int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:])) == 1 and (stdin.split()[1:].count(str(min(int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:]))) == stdin.split()[1:].count(str(max(int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:])))) or (stdin.split()[1:].count(str(min(int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:]))) == stdin.split()[1:].count(str(max(int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:]))) + 1)) else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: If there are exactly two distinct numbers differing by 1, their counts must be equal (for even n) or differ by at most 1 (for odd n) to form a valid circle.
